title: Survive the storm
description: A storm is coming. You are alone in an open field with trees to the southwest and a stone outcrop to the northeast. Survive by being inside an enclosed space when the storm hits at turn 30. How you shape, size, or build that space is up to you — any materials, any location, any strategy.
goal: Be inside an enclosed space of your own making by turn 30.
notes: Pure enclosure framing: no minimum floor area, no minimum placed-block count, no shape prescription.
Validity check: the air cell the agent occupies must not reach the world edge (BFS-bounded volume). Natural terrain may form any part of the boundary.
Design intent: observe how a creature chooses to build — free-form creativity is the target. Minecraft-style: dig a pit, nestle between trees, wall off a corner, build a tower, whatever works.
